//: Per-agent sentinel (L2/L3) config — independent of the L1 plugin config. The installer (adapters/install-sentinel.sh) fills stateDir with the agent's own events dir so L1 + L2/L3 show up in THAT agent's WebUI.

nativeJudge.//: mode: observe = detect+log+WebUI, never block | enforce = let lsm deny in-kernel

probes.//: ebpf/uprobe = observe only; lsm = in-kernel enforce (needs kernel >=5.7 + BTF + bpf in LSM list, and nativeJudge.mode=enforce)

ebpf.//lifecycle: Enable fork/exec/exit process tracking (M10 P1.2). Increases event volume significantly.

eventQueue.//maxDepth: Max events buffered between probe input and judge processing. Overflow drops new events with a counted marker in the JSONL log.
eventQueue.//sampleRate: Sampling rate 0..1 (default 1.0 = no sampling). Under burst, sets the fraction of events accepted before the queue check.

attribution.//: M11: attribution + correlation + causal-chain engine. All optional; unset values fall back to engine defaults.
attribution.//correlationWindowMs: How long a tool-call → syscall correlation window stays open (default 30000).
attribution.//causalWindowMs: How far back the causal-chain detector looks (default 60000).
attribution.//staleNodeMs: Process-tree stale threshold in ms (default 300000 = 5 min).
attribution.//pruneNodeMs: Process-tree prune threshold in ms (default 600000 = 10 min, guards against PID reuse).
attribution.//maxCausalPerSession: Cap on events kept per session for causal detection (default 500).

context.//: M11.5: session-level event context pipeline for AI/rule judges.

buffer.//maxPerSession: Max events retained per session (default 200). Oldest events are dropped when exceeded.
buffer.//maxSessions: Max sessions tracked before LRU eviction (default 64).
buffer.//sessionTtlMs: Idle session expiry in ms (default 300000 = 5 min).

behaviorJudge.//: M12: configurable behavior/sequence detection over the session context. Defaults should start in observe mode.

responsePolicy.//: M13: response ladder + policy engine. Default to observe; promote to enforce only after tuning.
